about.headline: About me
about.introductionText: My programming journey started in childhood and was deepened through an intensive Front-End bootcamp at the Developer Akademie. The dynamic tech world constantly inspires me, and I look forward to contributing to meaningful projects.
about.locationText: Based in Siegen, NRW, I am open to remote positions but cannot relocate.
about.learningText: I am passionate about learning new technologies and continuously advancing my skills.
about.solvingText: My problem-solving style is hands-on and iterative. I work well independently but actively seek collaboration on tougher challenges, blending careful planning with actionable solutions.

skills.headline: Skills
skills.description: Through hands-on work with diverse projects, I've built strong skills in modern frontend technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I'm always eager to learn and adapt to new tools and frameworks. For me, continuous growth is essential to stay current in the fast-evolving field of web development.
skills.followup: Enthusiastic about learning new technologies and frameworks.

portfolio.description: Explore a selection of my work — interact with the projects to see my skills in action.

elpollo.description: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy chicken.

pokedex.description: Interactive Pokémon catalog fetching live data from the PokéAPI. Browse, search, and view detailed stats for hundreds of Pokémon.

videoflix.description: REST API backend for a Netflix-style streaming platform. Manages user accounts, videos, and adaptive HLS playback - all via HTTP endpoints.

quizly.description: REST API backend that turns YouTube videos into multiple-choice quizzes. Extracts audio, transcribes it via speech-to-text, and generates structured quiz questions using AI.

coderr.description: REST API backend for a freelancer platform. Providers create tiered offers, customers place orders, and completed jobs get reviewed - all via HTTP endpoints.

kanmind.description: REST API backend for a Kanban-style project management tool built with Django REST Framework, supporting boards, task management, and comments.

join.description: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organize tasks using drag & drop, assign users and categories.

portfolioProject.description: Personal portfolio website built with Angular, featuring bilingual content, an EmailJS-powered contact form, and live project showcases.

privacy.intro: This privacy notice explains the nature, scope and purpose of processing personal data on this website.

hosting.head: Hosting
hosting.text: This website is hosted at altintorba.de and https://altintorba.duckdns.org on a privately operated server. When the website is accessed, the web server (nginx) automatically records access data (including IP address, date and time of access, page requested, browser type) in a log file. This data is used exclusively for technical security and error analysis and is not shared with third parties. A mirror version of this website is additionally available via GitHub Pages at https://altintorba.github.io/portfolio-altin/. Accessing this version may involve processing of access data by GitHub (GitHub, Inc., USA) as part of standard server operation. For details, see GitHub's Privacy Statement: https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement.

contactForm.head: Contact Form
contactForm.text: If you contact me via the contact form, your name, e-mail address and message are processed exclusively to handle your request. The form is powered by EmailJS (EmailJS Corp., USA), a third-party service that transmits your message to my e-mail inbox. Processing is based on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) and my legitimate interest in responding to inquiries (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

retention.head: Data Retention
retention.text: Personal data submitted via the contact form is deleted once your inquiry has been fully resolved, unless a longer retention period is required by law.
